_comment: Reference only. The authoritative copy lives in C:\ProgramData\OZK-TOBACCO\DeployGate\gate-config.json (writable by Administrators/SYSTEM only). A merge to main never changes the installed copy.
_releaseApp: Release identity (2026-10-21): GitHub App 'OZK Windows Release', installed on this repository only. windows-release.yml mints a short-lived installation token inside the approved release job (environment windows-production) right before the push, limited to this repository and exactly contents:write + workflows:write (workflows is required because releases fast-forward commits that change .github/workflows). RELEASE_APP_ID must equal appId; the private key is the environment secret RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY. Neither id is secret.
_deviceBaselineSha: Gap 3 (2026-10-20 audit): the SHA the device actually runs (OZK2026 reflog: manual merges after the 09-28 freeze left it on main@1843024, ahead of windows-production@88ae841). The gate and the release workflow refuse any target that does not contain it, so no release can roll the device back. Raise it only after a verified re-baseline.
_startGuardSeconds: Gap e: a task that is not routed through run-repo-task.ps1 does not honour deploying.flag, so the gate refuses to switch files when such a task is due to start within this many seconds (no race between the idle check and the merge).
_pauseTasks: The gate waits until none of these is Running (and refuses if any is not visible to its account: run the gate as SYSTEM). Gap c: the two backup tasks run pinned code from ProgramData but pass the repository's tools/send-telegram-notification.ps1 as -NotifyScript, so a deploy must not swap that file under them.
_routingExempt: Tasks whose own code is pinned outside the repository (they only call into it). They cannot honour deploying.flag, so the gate applies startGuardSeconds to them instead of requiring run-repo-task.ps1. Every other enabled pauseTask must be routed through run-repo-task.ps1 before -Mode Deploy (DryRun only warns).

writeScan._comment: Static detection of Ameen write capability in changed files (case-insensitive regexes, shared by the release workflow and the gate). A defence in depth only: every script uses a SQL login that can write, so the real control is a read-only login for readers (separate owner decision).

longRunningComponents.name: TOBACCO Ameen Read Worker
longRunningComponents.runner: Scheduled Task (LOQ; Boot + every 10 min, IgnoreNew) -> powershell -File tools/ameen-read-worker.ps1, one long process. Not visible to OZKSync: the gate must run as SYSTEM.

longRunningComponents.name: OZK-AmeenAutoPrint
longRunningComponents.runner: Scheduled Task (LOQ, LOGON trigger, not ONSTART) -> wscript C:\ProgramData\OZK-TOBACCO\TaskWrappers\ozk-ameen-autoprint-hidden.vbs -> tools/ameen-autoprint/run-watcher.bat (untracked, gitignored) -> node watcher.js

longRunningComponents.name: OZK-Tobacco-Server (scripts/serve.mjs)
longRunningComponents.runner: Legacy startup item OZK-Tobacco-Server.vbs (LOQ logon) -> node scripts/serve.mjs. Not running on 2026-10-20: the live local server is the TOBACCO Local Web Server task (see liveServedFromRepo).

liveServedFromRepo._comment: Gap a: the live local web server is NOT scripts/serve.mjs. Task 'TOBACCO Local Web Server' (OZKSync, every 5 min) runs node C:\ProgramData\OZK-TOBACCO\LocalWebServer\server.mjs, a pinned copy outside the repository whose ROOT is repoPath. It reads static files per request, so a deploy changes what LAN clients get immediately, with no restart. The gate records these paths as live_served_changed (information, never a restart).
liveServedFromRepo.name: TOBACCO Local Web Server

mainWorktree._comment: Dedicated main checkout ONLY for tasks that must run on main (Codex P1 #5). Never a path to update operational Windows scripts: the gate never touches it and run-repo-task.ps1 refuses scripts outside repoPath. It must be a separate worktree/clone on main with the official remote before the operational repo is switched to windows-production.
mainWorktree._state20261025: Diagnosis 2026-10-25: no task uses this path any more. OZK-PriceListSync (Disabled since 2026-09-07) ran from tobacco-web-main-sync and is now in retiredMainTasks; mainDependentTasks is empty, so the preflight no longer needs this worktree to be on main.
